Holiday shopping has started…are your campaigns ready?
Unwrap 2026 holiday shopping trends, foot traffic insights, and high-impact targeting and measurement strategies to help your campaigns shine and drive results this season.
Get the holiday guide
 
The trusted leader in location technology & data
Unlock revenue, marketing, and product strategies across business needs. Enrich data, power POI in apps, boost usage, and conduct competitive analysis.
See our products
Quality at scale
Stop-detection precisely maps visits to locations. Over 16B check-ins fuel a dynamic map of 100M+ POIs across 200+ countries, capturing 9B+ monthly visits from 500M+ devices worldwide
Privacy-forward
Data privacy is important to us. Consumers have full control over their data, and our partners undergo regular audits to help ensure privacy standards are upheld.
Expertise
With 15+ years perfecting our best-in-class location technology, we are committed to scaling with you as your needs evolve.
Flexibility
With 550+ integrated partners, from AWS to the Trade Desk, our data is accessible and delivered via your preferred sources and formats.
Leading brands use Foursquare

Committed to data privacy
Foursquare’s proprietary technology provides businesses with accurate, trusted location data. We believe it’s our responsibility to be an industry leader in data privacy, the ethical use of consumer data, and promoting best practices.
Learn more about our data privacy standards

Products
 
 
 
 
Product overview
Building the #1 location technology platform
With best-in-class accuracy, accessibility, scale, and respect for consumer data privacy, our location technology platform provides data solutions and tools for real business problems.
Find the tools for you
Marketers
Power more personalized campaigns that drive ROI with accurate targeting and omnichannel measurement
Geospatial
Transform location data into actionable insights with purpose-built tools that speak your language
Developers
Drive engagement and revenue with timely, context-driven app experiences
 
For marketers
Transform your advertising
Do you know if your advertising is making a difference on foot traffic to your locations? Take your marketing investment further by using location data to better understand your customers and target them on their journey towards your brand.
Attribution
Understand the true impact of your advertising on net new customer behavior with the ability to measure your entire media plan cross-platform with FSQ/Attribution.
Learn more
Audience
Reach effective, highly-customizable audiences based on real-world behaviors with easy-to-activate targeting across every channel.
Learn more
Proximity
Reach consumers in real-time using geo-contextual targeting. Build accurate, custom geofences to programmatically connect with consumers in key moments of receptivity.
Learn more
 
For developers
Power your location-based apps with our suite of developer tools
Use location intelligence to create timely, context-driven app experiences that drive engagement and revenue. Get familiar with our products and explore their features.
Places
Foursquare Places data unlocks locations with precision and in rich detail. Know where you’ll build your next retail location. Analyze economic and foot-traffic trends, or build powerful POI applications.
Learn more
OS Places
Open source, high-quality POI data to drive innovation across the entire geospatial community.
Learn more
Movement SDK
Drive customer engagement (and revenue) by personalizing in-app content at precisely the right time with developer and integration friendly tools.
Learn more
Places APIs
Get real-time data access to increase customer satisfaction, build a better app experience and help users discover venues nearby.
Learn more
 
For analysts and ML engineers
Bring your data. Bring your questions. Build the answers.
Geospatial intelligence for everyone. Whether you’re a developer, analyst, or GIS expert, transform location data into actionable insights with purpose-built tools that speak your language. Built on three foundational pillars, Data, Visualization, and Compute, our platform transforms how organizations leverage location data for business intelligence.
Spatial H3 Hub
H3 Hub delivers dozens of raster and vector datasets pre-processed into H3-indexed tables, eliminating months of spatial data preparation for training your ML models. Query demographics, mobility, and environmental data at any H3 resolution directly from Spark, Python, or DuckDB, using simple lat/long coordinates or region boundaries.
Learn 
more
Spatial Workbench
Spatial Workbench combines familiar SQL workbooks with pre-provisioned geospatial compute engines like MotherDuck and inline 
Kepler.gl
 visualizations, so analysts can query datasets, create stunning maps, and publish interactive spatial stories – all within a single browser workspace.
Learn more
Spatial Desktop
Spatial Desktop unleashes the full power of geospatial visualization on your workstation, combining GPU rendering with native DuckDB performance to handle tens of millions of points, run sub-second spatial SQL, and work seamlessly even when connectivity is limited.
Learn more
Spatial Studio
A visualization playground for map-making, advanced analytics, and collaboration – all in a cloud-based geospatial workspace. Access experimental Kepler features before they make their way into 
Kepler.gl
 OSS and other FSQ Spatial products.
Learn more
 
Get started with Foursquare
Interested in exploring how Foursquare can help drive your business forward with location technology? We’d love to show you how.

Spatial Desktop
 
Features available across all plans
–
 
For GIS professionals:
 Advanced desktop software for tech-savvy users.
– Powered by Kepler.gl & DuckDB:
 Combines powerful visualization with high-performance spatial queries.
– Superior performance:
 Sub-second queries on large datasets, real-time rendering.
– End-to-end workflow:
 Supports project creation, data import, querying, visualization, and interaction.
– Flexible & offline capable:
 Local/cloud saving, full analytical power without internet.

Places API
 
Pay for what you use.
 Flexible, volume-based pricing based on your monthly usage of Pro & Premium endpoints with the Foursquare Places API. More calls mean more savings.
Places API Pro endpoints
Pro endpoints include Place Search, Place Details, Autocomplete, Place Match & Geotagging Candidates when requested with default fields.
0 – 500 Calls
501 to 100,000 Calls
100,001 to 500,000 Calls
500,001+ Calls
$0.00 CPM
$15.00 CPM
$12.00 CPM
$9.00 CPM
Places API Premium endpoints
Premium endpoints include Tips & Photos. Search, Details, Place Match & Geotagging Candidates are Premium endpoints when requested with premium tier fields.
0 – 100,000 Calls
100,001 to 500,000 Calls
500,001+ Calls
$18.75 CPM
$15.00 CPM
$11.25 CPM

Ask API endpoints can be considered Pro or Premium based on the 
requested fields

rate limits
 for Ask API.
